spans.s:
जिम् जिम् [cf. छम्, जम्, झम्], cl. 1. P.
जेमति, &c., to eat.

जिम्भ जिम्भ, perhaps for जृम्भ in जिम्-
भ-जिह्व-ता, swelling of the tongue.

जीमूत जीमूत, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 1.
जि), a cloud; a mountain; N. of the sun; N. of
Indra; a nourisher, a sustainer; the plant Lipeo-
cercis Serrata; also Luffa Fœtida or a similar plant;
a kind of Cyperus; a kind of metre; N. of an
ancient sage; of a certain wrestler; of a son of
Vyoman.
—जीमूत-कुट, अस्, m. a small hill near
a mountain.
—जीमूत-केतु, उस्, m. an epithet of
Śiva; N. of a prince of the Vidyā-dharas.
—जीमूत-
मूल, अम्, n. Curcuma Amhaldi or Zerumbet.
—जीमूत-वाहन, अस्, m. an epithet of Indra; N.
[]
of a son of king Śāli-vāhana; N. of a son of Jīmūta-
ketu; N. of a lawyer, author of the Dāya-bhāga.
—जीमूत-वाहिन्, ई, m. smoke.
—जीमूत-स्वन-
सन्निभ, अस्, आ, अम्, like the sound of a cloud.
—जीमूताष्टमी (˚त-अष्˚), f., N. of a festival in
honour of Jīmūta-vāhana, son of Śāli-vāhana, on
the eighth day in the dark half of month Āśvina.
जीमूतक, अस्, m. the plant Lipeocercis Serrata.
